@package unison-util-file-embed

module Unison.Util.FileEmbed
embedProjectStringFile :: FilePath -> Q Exp

-- | The file's contents as a <a>Text</a>. The bytes are a literal in the
--   object code (<a>embedFile</a>); the decode runs once, when the value
--   is first forced.
embedProjectTextFile :: FilePath -> Q Exp

-- | The files in a directory (and its subdirectories), as pairs of their
--   paths (relative to the directory) and their contents as <a>Text</a>. A
--   file that is changed makes the module recompile, but a file that is
--   added doesn't, until something else does.
embedProjectTextDir :: FilePath -> Q Exp
